caption: A picture frame hanging on a wall comes loose from its nail and falls to the floor.

sa.check: A picture frame hangs on a wall from a nail.
It comes loose from the nail.
The frame comes loose first and the fall follows.

pc.expect: The frame hangs as long as the nail holds it and starts to move only once it is free of the nail.
pc.fail: The frame falls while still hooked over the nail; or its wire leaves the nail and the frame stays hanging in place; or the frame slides down the wall with the nail still through its wire.

pc.expect: Once free the frame drops down along the wall and reaches the floor.
pc.fail: The frame drifts outward away from the wall as it falls; or it stops in the air part way down; or it rises up the wall.

pc.expect: It tips or slews as it comes off, turns as it drops, and ends lying or leaning at the foot of the wall.
pc.fail: The frame stays perfectly level all the way down and lands standing upright; or it swings back up the wall after hitting the floor; or it rebounds higher than the nail it fell from.

pc.expect: The frame stays rigid as it lands and the wall stays solid where it brushes past.
pc.fail: The frame bends like cloth as it falls; or it bounces off the floor like a ball and stays up in the air; or the wall dents inward where the frame touches it.

pc.expect: One frame on one nail keeps its shape and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The frame vanishes on the way down or a second one appears; or the frame passes through the wall or the floor; or it turns into another object as it falls.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The picture inside the frame, the wall and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The picture inside changes to a different image; or the wall changes colour; or the furniture in the room rearranges between frames.
